# ADR 0005: Nightly arrears job with a single-runner lock

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Loan amortisation and repayment service

## Context

Ageing and penalties must run once per day even with several instances.

## Decision

Run the job via @Scheduled (or a cloud scheduler) and guard it with a PostgreSQL advisory lock; make it idempotent per business date.

## Consequences

Safe re-runs and multi-instance deployment.

## Alternatives considered

Running penalties on read (inconsistent reports).
